verdict_rationale: Rescan confirms IA executed 2025-07-30 (filed PUCT 2025-08-26, control 35077 item 2239) with a real financial security ($15,508,166 combined ISLOC for 24INR0118+24INR0375, effective on/before 2025-07-01); developer chain resolved (PK Solar, LLC f/k/a Novis Renewables, LLC, c/o Nadara Development US, LLC / Nadara North America, Inc.); Ch.313 value-limitation agreement #1728 with Graford ISD has been LIVE since 2022-11-21 and was still being administratively amended as recently as 2025-12-16/2026-03-05 -- an actively-managed real project, not a paper filing. Companion BESS 24INR0375 (PK Solar LLC (BESS)) co-tenant at the same Halsell Ranch Switch switchyard corroborates. HOWEVER: 5-date Sentinel-2 imagery (2024-07 through 2026-07) plus a wide 13km verification frame show ZERO visible construction/grading at the resolved site through the latest clear acquisition (2026-07-07) -- with In-Service Date contractually 2027-05-13, that leaves only ~10 months of runway for a 262 MW build with no ground-disturbance yet visible. Verdict stays 'real_early' (real, financially/administratively active, but not yet under construction).

site.derivation_notes: Ch.313 agreement #1728 (Graford ISD) Checklist Item #11 includes actual MAP exhibits (highest provenance rung): a project-boundary/solar-panel-footprint map and a 'Proposed Reinvestment Zone' map anchored at a labeled landmark, 'Marluc Bella Vita Ranch'. That ranch/lodge's own site (lakegodstone.com, WebFetch) gives its address as '4636 Halsell Ranch Road, Graford, TX 76449' -- independently matching the executed IA's Exhibit C interconnection-details text, which names the POI 'Halsell Ranch Switch' on the Thomas Price-Willow Creek 345kV line in Jack County (the station-location sentence itself is REDACTED as CEII per Oncor's PUCT cover letter). Cross-referenced the place name via Overpass/OSM: 'Halsell Ranch Road' (TIGER, tiger:county=Jack,TX, spanning 33.030-33.046N/-98.331 to -98.271W) and 'Halsell Ranch Cemetery' (GNIS feature_id 1337264, a federally-documented named place) at 33.0318N,-98.2947W -- used as the anchor. Three independent public records (Ch.313 map, IA Exhibit C place name, GNIS/TIGER) converge; no single rung was sufficient alone (IA coordinates redacted; Ch.313 map has no lat/lon graticule). NOT parcel-precise -- a ~1km-radius place-name anchor. Nominatim and the Census geocoder both returned zero matches for the literal street address (too rural); Overpass/TIGER was the path that worked. Full chain: sources/SITE_DERIVATION.md.

evidence: 5-date Sentinel-2 imagery at the resolved anchor (33.0318,-98.2947), 2024-07-12 through 2026-07-07, all cloud <=25% and unobstructed at the anchor: land use is IDENTICAL rangeland/ranch-track pattern across all 5 dates. No grading, no panel rows, no laydown yard.

Supplementary wide 13km frame (6.5km buffer, 2026-07-07) covering the full mapped reinvestment zone from Marluc Bella Vita Ranch (north) to FM 337 (south) also shows no construction anywhere in that envelope.

Positive control: checked data/eia_generator_tx.parquet (latest reportDate 2026-05-01) for Jack/Palo Pinto operating plants before attributing any array -- found Hecate Energy Longhorn Solar LLC (entity Repsol Renewables NA), 650MW, (OP) Operating, at 33.04417N/-98.34052W, ~4.5km west. A dedicated probe chip there confirms its distinctive panel-row grid IS clearly visible in Sentinel-2 at this resolution, and it is spatially distinct from (not overlapping) the Possum Kingdom Solar anchor in the wide frame -- proves the imagery source resolves construction when present and rules out misattribution.
IA Exhibit B's own Notice-to-Proceed date (2025-07-01) is now more than a year in the past with zero visible ground-disturbance -- a genuine schedule-risk finding, not an imagery gap.

The ERCOT queue's self-reported construction_start (2025-05-01) / construction_end (2026-05-08) milestone fields are contradicted by imagery -- both dates have passed with no visible activity; treat those two queue fields as unreliable for this project.
